dismal.songTitle: You Turn Me On, I’m a Radio
dismal.line: And you wind up cracking and the day goes dismal
stanza: 'Cause honey, who needs the static, it hurts the head
And you wind up cracking and the day goes dismal
From "Breakfast Barney" to the sign-off prayer
What a sorry face you get to wear
I'm going to tell you again now if you're still listening there

dismal.line: Down by the ocean it was so dismal
stanza: Down by the ocean it was so dismal
Women all standing with shock on their faces
Sad description, oh, I was looking for you
